title: so / neither partial inversion · 阶段复盘(第4轮)
summary: so/neither indicates 'the same is true (not)' and takes partial inversion, avoiding repetition.本课为阶段复盘练习,核心:so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。
points: So do I = I do too
Neither do I = I don't either
the auxiliary matches the previous sentence
So + subject + auxiliary means indeed so (no inversion)
the tense agrees with the previous sentence

examples.en: I like traveling, and so does my sister.
examples.zh: 我喜欢旅行,我妹妹也是。

examples.en: He can't drive, and neither can I.
examples.zh: 他不会开车,我也不会。

examples.en: They went to the museum, and so did we.
examples.zh: 他们去了博物馆,我们也去了。

examples.en: I have never been to Paris, and neither has he.
examples.zh: 我没去过巴黎,他也没去过。

examples.en: She is a nurse, and so am I.
examples.zh: 她是护士,我也是。

examples.en: You won't give up, and neither shall we.
examples.zh: 你们不会放弃,我们也不会。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: I like traveling, and so do my sister.
I like traveling, and does so my sister.
I like traveling, and so is my sister.
I like traveling, and so does my sister.
questions.explanation: so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。正确句:I like traveling, and so does my sister.

questions.prompt: 「他不会开车,我也不会。」的正确英文是?
options: He can't drive, and neither do I.
He can't drive, and neither can I.
He can't drive, and neither can't I.
He can't drive, and can neither I.
questions.explanation: 考查so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。正确句:He can't drive, and neither can I.

questions.prompt: They went to the museum, and _____ we.
options: did so
so did
so were
so do
questions.explanation: 考查so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。此处应为 so did。句意:他们去了博物馆,我们也去了。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: I have never been to Paris, and has neither he.
I have never been to Paris, and neither haven't he.
I have never been to Paris, and neither does he.
I have never been to Paris, and neither has he.
questions.explanation: so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。正确句:I have never been to Paris, and neither has he.

questions.prompt: 「她是护士,我也是。」的正确英文是?
options: She is a nurse, and am so I.
She is a nurse, and so am I.
She is a nurse, and so do I.
She is a nurse, and so is I.
questions.explanation: 考查so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。正确句:She is a nurse, and so am I.

questions.prompt: You won't give up, and _____ we.
options: neither do
shall neither
neither shall
neither will not
questions.explanation: 考查so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。此处应为 neither shall。句意:你们不会放弃,我们也不会。

title: Cleft sentences It is...that · 阶段复盘(第4轮)
summary: Cleft sentences emphasize the subject, object or adverbial: It is...that/who..., the tense stays unchanged.本课为阶段复盘练习,核心:It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。
points: emphasizing a person: It is...who...
emphasizing a time/place adverbial: It was...that...
not the predicate can be emphasized
the cleft sentence does not change the sentence's meaning
distinguished from the formal subject It is...that

examples.en: It was Tom who broke the window.
examples.zh: 是汤姆打破了窗户。

examples.en: It is English that we practice every morning.
examples.zh: 我们每天早上练的是英语。

examples.en: It was in February that they first met.
examples.zh: 他们是在二月初次见面的。

examples.en: It is my mother who cooks for us every day.
examples.zh: 每天给我们做饭的是我妈妈。

examples.en: It was at the station that I lost my bag.
examples.zh: 我是在车站丢的包。

examples.en: It is hard work that leads to success.
examples.zh: 是努力通向成功。

questions.prompt: 「是汤姆打破了窗户。」的正确英文是?
options: It was Tom which broke the window.
It was Tom whom broke the window.
It was Tom that whom broke the window.
It was Tom who broke the window.
questions.explanation: 考查It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。正确句:It was Tom who broke the window.

questions.prompt: It is English _____ we practice every morning.
options: that
what
which
who
questions.explanation: 考查It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。此处应为 that。句意:我们每天早上练的是英语。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: It was in February that they first met.
It was in February which they first met.
It was in February when they first met.
It was in February what they first met.
questions.explanation: It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。正确句:It was in February that they first met.

questions.prompt: 「每天给我们做饭的是我妈妈。」的正确英文是?
options: It is my mother whom cooks for us every day.
It is my mother which cooks for us every day.
It is my mother whose cooks for us every day.
It is my mother who cooks for us every day.
questions.explanation: 考查It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。正确句:It is my mother who cooks for us every day.

questions.prompt: It was at the station _____ I lost my bag.
options: that
when
which
where
questions.explanation: 考查It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。此处应为 that。句意:我是在车站丢的包。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: It is hard work which leads to success.
It is hard work that leads to success.
It is hard work what leads to success.
It is hard work who leads to success.
questions.explanation: It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。正确句:It is hard work that leads to success.

title: Formal subject it · 阶段复盘(第4轮)
summary: it acts as formal subject, replacing the real subject (infinitive or clause) placed later.本课为阶段复盘练习,核心:It is + adjective/noun + to do / that clause。
points: It is important to learn English.
It takes time to master a skill.
It is said that... reportedly
It is + adjective + for sb to do
It is kind of sb to do (evaluating a person's character uses of)

examples.en: It is important to keep a diary in English.
examples.zh: 用英语写日记很重要。

examples.en: It takes about an hour to get to the library.
examples.zh: 到图书馆大约需要一个小时。

examples.en: It is said that the bridge has a long history.
examples.zh: 据说这座桥历史悠久。

examples.en: It is necessary for us to take notes in class.
examples.zh: 我们有必要在课堂上记笔记。

examples.en: It is kind of you to help me with math.
examples.zh: 你帮我学数学,真是太好了。

examples.en: It is no use crying over spilt milk.
examples.zh: 事后后悔是没有用的。

questions.prompt: It is important _____ a diary in English.
options: keep
to keeping
keeping
to keep
questions.explanation: 考查It is + adjective/noun + to do / that clause。此处应为 to keep。句意:用英语写日记很重要。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: It takes about an hour get to the library.
It takes about an hour to get to the library.
It takes about an hour getting to the library.
It takes about an hour to getting to the library.
questions.explanation: It is + adjective/noun + to do / that clause。正确句:It takes about an hour to get to the library.

questions.prompt: 「据说这座桥历史悠久。」的正确英文是?
options: It is said that the bridge has a long history.
It says that the bridge has a long history.
It is say that the bridge has a long history.
That is said the bridge has a long history.
questions.explanation: 考查It is + adjective/noun + to do / that clause。正确句:It is said that the bridge has a long history.

questions.prompt: It is necessary _____ notes in class.
options: us to take
for us to take
for us taking
of us to take
questions.explanation: 考查It is + adjective/noun + to do / that clause。此处应为 for us to take。句意:我们有必要在课堂上记笔记。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: It is kind for you to help me with math.
It is kind you to help me with math.
It is kind of you helping me with math.
It is kind of you to help me with math.
questions.explanation: It is + adjective/noun + to do / that clause。正确句:It is kind of you to help me with math.

questions.prompt: 「事后后悔是没有用的。」的正确英文是?
options: It is no use to crying over spilt milk.
It is no use to cry over spilt milk.
It is no use crying over spilt milk.
It is no use cry over spilt milk.
questions.explanation: 考查It is + adjective/noun + to do / that clause。正确句:It is no use crying over spilt milk.

title: Formal object it · 阶段复盘(第4轮)
summary: it acts as formal object, replacing the infinitive or clause object placed after the complement.本课为阶段复盘练习,核心:Subject + verb + it + complement + real object (to do/that clause)。
points: find it + adjective + to do
think it + noun + to do
make it + adjective + that
it refers to the real object placed later
common verbs: find, think, make, consider

examples.en: I find it helpful to read aloud every morning.
examples.zh: 我发现每天早晨朗读很有帮助。

examples.en: She thinks it a good habit to make lists.
examples.zh: 她认为列清单是个好习惯。

examples.en: We make it a rule to clean the room on Monday.
examples.zh: 我们规定星期一打扫房间。

examples.en: Do you consider it worth trying again?
examples.zh: 你认为值得再试一次吗?

examples.en: The noise made it hard to fall asleep.
examples.zh: 噪音让人难以入睡。

examples.en: I believe it possible to finish it in a week.
examples.zh: 我相信一周内完成是可能的。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: I find it helpful to read aloud every morning.
I find it helpful read aloud every morning.
I find that helpful to read aloud every morning.
I find it's helpful to read aloud every morning.
questions.explanation: Subject + verb + it + complement + real object (to do/that clause)。正确句:I find it helpful to read aloud every morning.

questions.prompt: 「她认为列清单是个好习惯。」的正确英文是?
options: She thinks it good habit to make lists.
She thinks it a good habit to make lists.
She thinks that a good habit to make lists.
She thinks it's a good habit to make lists.
questions.explanation: 考查Subject + verb + it + complement + real object (to do/that clause)。正确句:She thinks it a good habit to make lists.

questions.prompt: We make _____ to clean the room on Monday.
options: it a rule
that a rule
it's a rule
it rule
questions.explanation: 考查Subject + verb + it + complement + real object (to do/that clause)。此处应为 it a rule。句意:我们规定星期一打扫房间。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: Do you consider it worth trying again?
Do you consider it's worth trying again?
Do you consider it worth to try again?
Do you consider that worth trying again?
questions.explanation: Subject + verb + it + complement + real object (to do/that clause)。正确句:Do you consider it worth trying again?

questions.prompt: 「噪音让人难以入睡。」的正确英文是?
options: The noise made it hard fall asleep.
The noise made it's hard to fall asleep.
The noise made that hard to fall asleep.
The noise made it hard to fall asleep.
questions.explanation: 考查Subject + verb + it + complement + real object (to do/that clause)。正确句:The noise made it hard to fall asleep.

questions.prompt: I believe _____ finish it in a week.
options: that possible to
it possible to
it possible
it's possible to
questions.explanation: 考查Subject + verb + it + complement + real object (to do/that clause)。此处应为 it possible to。句意:我相信一周内完成是可能的。

title: with compound structures · 阶段复盘(第4轮)
summary: The with compound structure expresses accompanying state; the complement is determined by the relation to the noun.本课为阶段复盘练习,核心:with + noun + complement (adjective/adverb/V-ing/past participle) as an adverbial or modifier。
points: with + noun + adjective: with the door open
with + noun + V-ing: active ongoing
with + noun + past participle: passive or completed
with + noun + prepositional phrase
independent of the sentence's subject

examples.en: He slept with the window open.
examples.zh: 他开着窗户睡觉。

examples.en: With the sun rising, the city became bright.
examples.zh: 太阳升起时,城市亮了起来。

examples.en: She stood there with her eyes closed.
examples.zh: 她闭着眼睛站在那里。

examples.en: With the homework done, we went out to play.
examples.zh: 做完作业后,我们出去玩了。

examples.en: The girl with a book in her hand is my sister.
examples.zh: 手里拿着书的那个女孩是我妹妹。

examples.en: He left with the lights on.
examples.zh: 他没关灯就走了。

questions.prompt: 「他开着窗户睡觉。」的正确英文是?
options: He slept with the window opened.
He slept with the window open.
He slept with the window opening.
He slept with the window opens.
questions.explanation: 考查with + noun + complement (adjective/adverb/V-ing/past participle) as an adverbial or modifier。正确句:He slept with the window open.

questions.prompt: With the sun _____, the city became bright.
options: risen
rising
rises
rose
questions.explanation: 考查with + noun + complement (adjective/adverb/V-ing/past participle) as an adverbial or modifier。此处应为 rising。句意:太阳升起时,城市亮了起来。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: She stood there with her eyes closing.
She stood there with her eyes close.
She stood there with her eyes closed.
She stood there with her eyes closes.
questions.explanation: with + noun + complement (adjective/adverb/V-ing/past participle) as an adverbial or modifier。正确句:She stood there with her eyes closed.

questions.prompt: 「做完作业后,我们出去玩了。」的正确英文是?
options: With the homework doing, we went out to play.
With the homework do, we went out to play.
With the homework done, we went out to play.
With the homework did, we went out to play.
questions.explanation: 考查with + noun + complement (adjective/adverb/V-ing/past participle) as an adverbial or modifier。正确句:With the homework done, we went out to play.

questions.prompt: The girl _____ a book in her hand is my sister.
options: with
has
of
which has
questions.explanation: 考查with + noun + complement (adjective/adverb/V-ing/past participle) as an adverbial or modifier。此处应为 with。句意:手里拿着书的那个女孩是我妹妹。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: He left with the lights opened.
He left with the lights open.
He left with the lights opening.
He left with the lights on.
questions.explanation: with + noun + complement (adjective/adverb/V-ing/past participle) as an adverbial or modifier。正确句:He left with the lights on.

title: Absolute constructions · 阶段复盘(第4轮)
summary: The absolute construction = noun + adjective/adverb/past participle/infinitive, as an adverbial expressing time, reason or accompanying state.本课为阶段复盘练习,核心:Noun + complement independent structure, separated from the main clause by a comma。
points: the logical subject differs from the main clause subject
noun + past participle: the work finished, ...
noun + adjective: the floor wet, ...
with the absolute can be preceded by with
generally not used in spoken language, common in written expression

examples.en: The work finished, we went home happily.
examples.zh: 工作完成后,我们高兴地回家了。

examples.en: The sun having set, we walked back in the dark.
examples.zh: 太阳落山后,我们在黑暗中走回来。

examples.en: Weather permitting, we'll climb the hill tomorrow.
examples.zh: 天气允许的话,我们明天去爬山。

examples.en: Her voice trembling, she told us the news.
examples.zh: 她声音颤抖地告诉我们这个消息。

examples.en: All things considered, it was a good plan.
examples.zh: 通盘考虑,这是个好计划。

examples.en: There being no bus, we had to walk home.
examples.zh: 没有公交车了,我们只好走回家。

questions.prompt: The work _____, we went home happily.
options: was finished
finish
finished
finishing
questions.explanation: 考查Noun + complement independent structure, separated from the main clause by a comma。此处应为 finished。句意:工作完成后,我们高兴地回家了。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: The sun setting, we walked back in the dark.
The sun has set, we walked back in the dark.
The sun set, we walked back in the dark.
The sun having set, we walked back in the dark.
questions.explanation: Noun + complement independent structure, separated from the main clause by a comma。正确句:The sun having set, we walked back in the dark.

questions.prompt: 「天气允许的话,我们明天去爬山。」的正确英文是?
options: Weather permitting, we'll climb the hill tomorrow.
Weather permitted, we'll climb the hill tomorrow.
Weather permits, we'll climb the hill tomorrow.
Weather to permit, we'll climb the hill tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 考查Noun + complement independent structure, separated from the main clause by a comma。正确句:Weather permitting, we'll climb the hill tomorrow.

questions.prompt: Her voice _____, she told us the news.
options: trembled
trembles
trembling
to tremble
questions.explanation: 考查Noun + complement independent structure, separated from the main clause by a comma。此处应为 trembling。句意:她声音颤抖地告诉我们这个消息。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: All things consider, it was a good plan.
All things considered, it was a good plan.
All things considers, it was a good plan.
All things considering, it was a good plan.
questions.explanation: Noun + complement independent structure, separated from the main clause by a comma。正确句:All things considered, it was a good plan.

questions.prompt: 「没有公交车了,我们只好走回家。」的正确英文是?
options: There is no bus, we had to walk home.
There been no bus, we had to walk home.
There being no bus, we had to walk home.
There was no bus, we had to walk home.
questions.explanation: 考查Noun + complement independent structure, separated from the main clause by a comma。正确句:There being no bus, we had to walk home.

title: Non-restrictive relative clauses · 阶段复盘(第4轮)
summary: Non-restrictive relative clauses add supplementary explanation; a comma is essential, that is forbidden.本课为阶段复盘练习,核心:Separated from the antecedent by a comma; that cannot be used; who/which are used。
points: a comma separates the main clause from the clause
that cannot introduce a non-restrictive clause
who guides a person, which guides a thing
which can refer to the whole previous sentence
the clause can be omitted without affecting the main meaning

examples.en: My father, who is sixty now, still works hard.
examples.zh: 我父亲现在六十岁了,仍然努力工作。

examples.en: The book, which I bought last week, is very useful.
examples.zh: 我上周买的这本书非常有用。

examples.en: He passed the exam, which made his parents happy.
examples.zh: 他通过了考试,这让他的父母很高兴。

examples.en: Beijing, which is the capital of China, has a long history.
examples.zh: 北京是中国的首都,历史悠久。

examples.en: Miss Li, who teaches us English, is very patient.
examples.zh: 教我们英语的李老师非常耐心。

examples.en: The summer camp, which lasted a week, ended yesterday.
examples.zh: 为期一周的夏令营昨天结束了。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: My father, whom he is sixty now, still works hard.
My father, that is sixty now, still works hard.
My father, which is sixty now, still works hard.
My father, who is sixty now, still works hard.
questions.explanation: Separated from the antecedent by a comma; that cannot be used; who/which are used。正确句:My father, who is sixty now, still works hard.

questions.prompt: 「我上周买的这本书非常有用。」的正确英文是?
options: The book, who I bought last week, is very useful.
The book, which I bought last week, is very useful.
The book, what I bought last week, is very useful.
The book, that I bought last week, is very useful.
questions.explanation: 考查Separated from the antecedent by a comma; that cannot be used; who/which are used。正确句:The book, which I bought last week, is very useful.

questions.prompt: He passed the exam, _____ made his parents happy.
options: what
which
that
it
questions.explanation: 考查Separated from the antecedent by a comma; that cannot be used; who/which are used。此处应为 which。句意:他通过了考试,这让他的父母很高兴。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: Beijing, who is the capital of China, has a long history.
Beijing, what is the capital of China, has a long history.
Beijing, which is the capital of China, has a long history.
Beijing, that is the capital of China, has a long history.
questions.explanation: Separated from the antecedent by a comma; that cannot be used; who/which are used。正确句:Beijing, which is the capital of China, has a long history.

questions.prompt: 「教我们英语的李老师非常耐心。」的正确英文是?
options: Miss Li, which teaches us English, is very patient.
Miss Li, that teaches us English, is very patient.
Miss Li, who teaches us English, is very patient.
Miss Li, whom teaches us English, is very patient.
questions.explanation: 考查Separated from the antecedent by a comma; that cannot be used; who/which are used。正确句:Miss Li, who teaches us English, is very patient.

questions.prompt: The summer camp, _____ lasted a week, ended yesterday.
options: that
what
which
who
questions.explanation: 考查Separated from the antecedent by a comma; that cannot be used; who/which are used。此处应为 which。句意:为期一周的夏令营昨天结束了。

title: Preposition + which / whom · 阶段复盘(第4轮)
summary: Preposition + which/whom structure in formal written style; the preposition comes from the collocation with the verb.本课为阶段复盘练习,核心:The preposition can be placed before which/whom: the house in which I live。
points: the preposition + which guides a thing
the preposition + whom guides a person
the preposition is determined by the collocation in the clause: live in → in which
in non-restrictive clauses that cannot take a preposition
the fixed collocation's preposition cannot be fronted

examples.en: This is the house in which I lived for ten years.
examples.zh: 这就是我住了十年的房子。

examples.en: The friend with whom I traveled is a nurse.
examples.zh: 和我一起旅行的那个朋友是一名护士。

examples.en: Do you remember the day on which we first met?
examples.zh: 你记得我们初次见面的那天吗?

examples.en: The way in which you study matters a lot.
examples.zh: 你学习的方式非常重要。

examples.en: He is the man from whom I learned the news.
examples.zh: 我就是从他那里得知这个消息的。

examples.en: The school for which I worked is very famous.
examples.zh: 我工作过的那所学校很有名。

questions.prompt: 「这就是我住了十年的房子。」的正确英文是?
options: This is the house that I lived for ten years.
This is the house in which I lived for ten years.
This is the house where in I lived for ten years.
This is the house which I lived for ten years.
questions.explanation: 考查The preposition can be placed before which/whom: the house in which I live。正确句:This is the house in which I lived for ten years.

questions.prompt: The friend _____ I traveled is a nurse.
options: whom who
with whom
who
that
questions.explanation: 考查The preposition can be placed before which/whom: the house in which I live。此处应为 with whom。句意:和我一起旅行的那个朋友是一名护士。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: Do you remember the day that we first met?
Do you remember the day on which we first met?
Do you remember the day when on we first met?
Do you remember the day which we first met?

title: Compound sentences and semicolons · 阶段复盘(第4轮)
summary: Semicolons join parallel clauses; the linking adverbs however/therefore need a semicolon before them.本课为阶段复盘练习,核心:Semicolons join two closely related clauses; a comma cannot join two sentences。
